proposals: Leafless graphics of a tree should keep the silhouette of the same variant's leafy sibling (trunk count, root form), so the leaf drop does not visibly reshape the tree. Evidence: variant_A.png has a flared buttress base, but sibling_AB_MangrovePalmA.png has open stilt roots. variant_B.png keeps sibling_AB_MangrovePalmB.png's stilt roots. No constraint states this now.

A 'palm' leafless graphic could be required to read as a palm (ringed trunk, few or no twig branches) rather than a generic bare deciduous tree. variant_B.png's twig-fork crown reads deciduous more than palm. variant_A.png's ringed trunks read palm. No constraint states this, and the siblings themselves branch.
